description: Shared movement hierarchy and peer grouping (REQ-001; C01, C02, C04) delivered through MovementIdentity / MovementList / MovementGroupHeader on the real /review and /workout routes (JOURNEY-001), with the accepted gallery state /gallery/refinements?state=cards (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d).
